items.headline: Canada-China: vyapar samjhota, tariff me katauti
items.detail: Carney-Xi mulakat ke baad China ne Canada ke suar ka maas aur seafood par tariff ghataaya; Canada ne cheeni steel par riyaayat badhaayi.
items.exam_angle: US tariff ke beech Canada-China vyapar — APEC aur vyapar yuddh pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Indonesia ke paas 6.6 teevrata ka bhookamp
items.detail: Banda Sea me Tual ke paas 6.6 teevrata ka bhookamp aaya, Australia tak jhatke mehsoos hue; sunami ka khatra nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: USGS aur BMKG ke alag aaklan — bhookamp mapan aur sunami chetavni pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Japan ne Russian vimanon par ladaku viman bheje
items.detail: Do sandehspad Russian viman Japan ke hawai kshetra me ghuse, Tokyo ne Moscow se kadha virodh jataaya.
items.exam_angle: APEC se pehle Japan-Russia tanaav — kshetriya suraksha pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope Leo ki South America yatra khatm
items.detail: 12 din, 50 karyakram aur 1.3 crore log — Lima me 15 lakh ki antim Mass ke saath Pope Leo ne Uruguay, Argentina aur Peru ki yatra samapt ki, phaphde ki surgery ke ek mahine baad.
items.exam_angle: Pope Leo XIV, Vatican aur Latin America — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: United Airlines me gadbad, 418 udaan deri se
items.detail: United Airlines ne kaha takniki gadbadi se uski udaanen deri se chali; FlightAware ke mutabik 418 udaanen deri se aur 21 radd hui, cyber hamle ka sanket nahi.
items.exam_angle: US aviation, FAA aur airline suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Moyale jhadap: 50,000 log Kenya bhaage
items.detail: Ethiopia ke Oromia-Somali seema vivad par Moyale me hinsa bhadki; UNHCR ke mutabik 22 October se 50,000 tak log Kenya bhaag chuke hain, zyadatar mahilayen aur bachche.
items.exam_angle: Ethiopia-Kenya seema, UNHCR aur sharanarthi sankat — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Trump: China me Kim se mil sakte hain
items.detail: Trump ne kaha Xi Jinping chahein to Kim Jong Un bhi Shenzhen aa sakte hain; 19 November ki Xi-Trump-Putin baithak se pehle yeh sanket aaya, jabki Pyongyang ne baatchit se inkar kiya hai.
items.exam_angle: APEC, US-China-Russia trilateral aur North Korea — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America ke bade banks ki seva thap
items.detail: Chase, Bank of America aur Wells Fargo ki online seva me dikkat aayi; JPMorgan ne software bug ko wajah bataya aur cyber hamle se inkar kiya, khate aur rakam surakshit bataye.
items.exam_angle: Banking system, digital payment aur cyber-suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: US court ne chhatra visa seema radd ki
items.detail: Boston ke Judge Saylor ne DHS ka niyam 'arbitrary, capricious' batakar radd kiya; chhatron ki 4 saal ki seema aur patrakaron ki 240 din ki seema khatm ho gayi.
items.exam_angle: US immigration, F-1/J-1/I visa niyam — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Crimean Bridge par doosri baar hamla
items.detail: 24 ghante me doosri baar Kerch Bridge par hamla hua; Crimea ke governor ne traffic band karne ki pushti ki, nuksan ki matra abhi saaf nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Kerch Bridge — Russia-Crimea supply route, UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz me chauthe tanker me aag
items.detail: Iran ki nausena ne kaha pichhle 24 ghante me chautha tanker Hormuz ke paas samudri mine se takrakar jal utha; UKMTO ne Oman ke paas ek aur tanker par hamle ki bhi khabar di, uska amla surakshit hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz, tel vyapar, samudri suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Russia ne Kyiv ke do pulon par hamla kiya
items.detail: Mayor Klitschko ke mutabik der raat Dnipro nadi ke uttari aur dakshini pulon par hamle hue, shahar ke kuchh hisson me pani-bijli band; Zelenskyy ne pehle hi bade hamle ki chetavni di thi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Kyiv — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Europe me holiday season par US aatank chetavni
items.detail: US dutavas ne kaha bheed-bhaad wale bazaar, transport hub aur pooja sthalon par hamle ka khatra hai; nagrikon ko satark rehne aur STEP me register karne ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: US travel advisory aur Europe suraksha — IR ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Kushner: Ukraine shanti vaarta me pragati
items.detail: US doot Kushner ne kaha yuddh khatm karne ki disha me pragati ho rahi hai; suraksha guarantee, EU sadasyata aur punarnirman — teen stambh bataye.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shanti vaarta, US-Russia-EU — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Russia ko North Korea se har mahine missile
items.detail: Zelensky ne kaha Russia ko North Korea se har mahine darjanon ballistic missile mil rahi hain; Ukraine ko bhi barabar ke hathiyar chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Russia-North Korea sainya sahyog, missile — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: US hawai yatra phir lagbhag samanya hui
items.detail: Somvar ko sirf 350 udanein radd hui — Shukravar ko 9,200 radd hui thin; chaar ghante ka deshvyapi ground stop 9/11 ke baad sabse lamba tha.
items.exam_angle: US aviation, FAA, hawai suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Imran Khan: 'Wapas zinda na aaun'
items.detail: Jail me band poorv PM Imran Khan ne sheersh nyayadhishon ko patra likha — ilaaj na mila to zinda wapas nahi aa sakte, BP 192-193 aur dil ko nuksan ka daava kiya; patni Bushra Bibi ke liye bhi ilaaj manga, sarkar ne daavon ko kharij kiya.
items.exam_angle: Pakistan, Imran Khan, Pakistan judiciary — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: U.S. Department of State, Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: Houthi Aden ke kareeb pahunche
items.detail: Sarkari fauj ke Bab el-Mandeb se peeche hatne ke baad Houthi ne dakshini tat par Khor Omairh tak ilaka kabza kiya — Aden se sirf 100 km door, sarkar ne sheher me suraksha badhai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen, Houthi, Bab el-Mandeb, Aden — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Germany ne Russia ki nayi suraksha yojana thukrai
items.detail: Videsh Mantri Wadephul ne Brussels me kaha — Europe ko nayi suraksha vyavastha nahi chahiye, maujooda samjhauton ka samman hi kaafi hai; France ne bhi Europe ki suraksha vyavastha bachane ki kasam khayi.
items.exam_angle: Germany, Russia, European security architecture, NATO — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Olaf Kosinsky, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0 de)

items.headline: Houthi ne Saudi par hamle ka aarop lagaya
items.detail: Houthi ne kaha Saudi ke do hamlo me Yemen me ek bacche samet 3 log mare gaye; Riyadh ne abhi koi jawab nahi diya, July se 2022 ka yuddhviram toota hua hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen, Houthi, Saudi Arabia — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Gaza me Hamas ke Rafah commander mare gaye
items.detail: Israel ke hamle me Hamas ke Rafah Brigade commander Samir Abu Younis mare gaye — Hamas aur IDF dono ne pushti ki; yuddhviram ke bawjood Gaza me hamle jaari hain.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Hamas, Gaza yuddhviram — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: South Africa: do hamlo me 17 mare
items.detail: Pretoria ke paas ek jhopdi me 9 aur Pietermaritzburg ke paas ek gaadi me 8 log mare gaye — Ravivar raat ke hamle, karan abhi agyaat, koi giraftari nahi.
items.exam_angle: South Africa, hinsak apradh, banduk hinsa — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine ka Russia par sabse bada drone hamla
items.detail: Raat bhar ke hamle me Russia ne 1,336 drone giraye ka dawa kiya — 29 October ka 1,254 wala record toota; Crimea ko jodne wala Kerch pull bhi nishana bana, Kremlin ne nuksan halka bataya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, drone yuddh, Kerch pull — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Teesra US aircraft carrier Middle East pahuncha
items.detail: USS Theodore Roosevelt Ravivar ko CENTCOM kshetra me pahuncha — ab kshetra me teen US carrier strike group; Pentagon ne abhi aupcharik pushti nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran tanav, Hormuz, nausena tainati — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
